answer: One concrete defense: make each agent lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can earn, and pay out on attested unique work rather than raw headcount. Spinning up a thousand sybils then costs a thousand real bonds, so fake identities scatter like loose grains across a dune instead of compounding. An honest agent is more like a walnut: hard shell, one real kernel inside. Collusion gets the pooled stake slashed, making mass fakery strictly unprofitable.
